notes.honesty: GTA VI released 19 November 2026. Where a guide's detail comes from the official description itself, it says so. No street addresses, NPC schedules or glitch steps are invented. Guides are honest about what is known: details from the description say so, and unverified items are marked 'check the cited guide'.
notes.missables: As far as the official descriptions show, no trophy is permanently missable: story missions can be replayed and open-world content stays available. The situational trophies flagged 'missable' can fail in the moment but are always retryable.
notes.sources: Every guide cites its sources. The official names, descriptions and grades come from the Exophase GTA VI trophy list; method details beyond the description are general GTA-series know-how or community readings, and anything unverified is marked 'check the cited guide'. PSNProfiles and PowerPyx are cited by name — this guide does not invent article URLs.

roadmap.blurb: Play the main plot straight through: Gone Fishing, then Chapters 1–4 in order, then the final mission. The six named story missions (Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory) land inside the chapters — their exact placement is not in the descriptions, so follow the mission markers. A Long Road (100%) is listed here because it is story-driven, but it only ticks over once the later phases are done.
roadmap.title: The Story

roadmap.blurb: Work the stranger mission strands. Five finales carry their own trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone); Strangers & Freaks asks for 8 complete strands, so finish those five first and top up with three more strangers. Bret's unique-animal hunt belongs to this phase too. Strands stay available after the credits — nothing here is permanently missable.
roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks

roadmap.blurb: Sample every activity type once for Master of None, then grind the counted ones: 20 different race wins, a Top Fun drone-race win at every location, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 250 stunts and 50 Challenges. The one-off activity trophies (Scooter Bros registrations, the showroom smash, bowling at Kolt & Associates) slot in here as you pass them.
roadmap.title: Activities

roadmap.blurb: One big exploration loop feeds several counters: 3 full card sets, 100 discovered vehicles, all 52 areas of Leonida, 100 WAiNK locations and every meditation spot. Buy the 8 garage properties as you go so discovered vehicles have a home. Use the cited guides' maps — the descriptions give counts, not locations.
roadmap.title: Collectibles & Exploration

roadmap.blurb: The situational trophies last, because they need setup: the partner wanted-level escape, the 3-shop robbery chain, 5 kills in one Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the Rhinos, the stealth jewelry robbery, 5 bank vaults, the armored-truck blitz, one illegal operation per gang, and the melee drive-by. Then the money totals ($250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent) and the cryptic one-offs (Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, the Ocean Beach cocktail). All of the situational ones are retryable — missable in the moment, never permanently lost.
roadmap.title: Combat, Money & Clean-up

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no extra task hiding behind it. Work the five roadmap phases in order and watch the tracker in this app fill up; the header shows your percentage and the per-grade counts. Nothing here is permanently missable as far as the descriptions show, so a slow, steady playthrough is the safest route. Save the situational trophies in phase 5 for last, when you know the map and the mechanics. Source: official trophy description (via Exophase).
